site.name: Battle Calls
site.fullName: Battle Calls: the unauthorized fight card
site.tagline: Two calls enter. One walks out.
site.referee: Scored weekly against the chart. No advice. No grudges. Nobody's permission.
site.rulesBlurb: Their words, not ours. The market is the referee. No grudges, no advice, no edits after the bell.
site.postFight: Respect to both corners. Putting a number on the record in public takes guts.
site.affiliation: Independent commentary. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by X or anyone featured. All names and marks belong to their owners.
site.affiliationShort: Unauthorized. Not affiliated with X or anyone featured.
site.footerLine: Independent commentary, entertainment only, not financial advice. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by X or anyone on the card. All names and marks belong to their owners.
site.teaser: Read the fine print before the bell.
site.unauthorized: "Unauthorized" means the people on the card did not participate in this site and did not agree to be scored here.
site.advice: Entertainment and education only. This is not financial, investment, or trading advice.
site.skill: A single call says nothing about overall skill.
site.fairUse: Posts are quoted under fair use and linked to the original. A later edit does not replace the locked wording. A deleted post is noted and is not republished.
site.position: Position disclosure: this site does not publish an editor's book, and no position is stated here. Nothing on the card is a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold.
site.shareLine: Quotes are brief and for commentary; please read and share the original post, not a copy from this site.

fights.label: EXHIBITION
fights.cardText: Round 2: @benjamincowen vs. @DrJStrategy on BTC. Two opposite calls, one chart, scored weekly.
fights.finalBellDetail: The Dec 12, 2026 Coinbase daily close (00:00 UTC, 7 PM ET). That is the date Cowen named. The bout tests only Thorne's near-term call, not his 2027 targets. The horizon and the levels were set by Battle Calls before judging.
fights.lede: Weighing in with a bull call first thrown at 2:43:13 PM ET on Nov 14, 2026. The bear call went on the record at 10:24:58 AM ET on Nov 16, 2026. No take-backs. Only near-term direction into Dec 12 is on this card.
fights.instrumentDetail: Coinbase BTC-USD spot. The daily close is the Coinbase daily candle close at 00:00 UTC (7 PM ET).
fights.dataSource: Coinbase BTC-USD spot. The daily close is the Coinbase daily candle close at 00:00 UTC (7 PM ET). Entries are the open of the first full 1-minute bar after each post: James Thorne $65,715.21 at Nov 14, 2026 19:44 UTC (call at 2:43:13 PM ET); Benjamin Cowen $64,184.30 at Nov 16, 2026 15:25 UTC (call at 10:24:58 AM ET). Each man is scored from his own entry. These are locked prints for judging, not a live quote. First daily close; no wicks.

fights.label: OFFICIAL TITLE FIGHT
fights.ogAlt: @markminervini vs. Ed Yardeni, S&P 500, Nov 5, 2026 and Nov 11, 2026
fights.cardText: Round 3: @markminervini vs. Ed Yardeni on SPX. Two opposite calls, one chart, scored weekly.
fights.finalBellDetail: Through the Dec 31, 2026 official SPX close.
fights.lede: In the bear corner, @markminervini, with the net-short stance and the stop first posted at 7:49:52 AM ET on Nov 11, 2026. In the bull corner, Ed Yardeni, on a TV call. No take-backs. The spoken wording of the TV call is not treated as locked until a tape check.
fights.instrumentDetail: Minervini's stop is judged in SPY; Yardeni's target and all decisions are judged on the official S&P 500 (SPX) close (S&P Dow Jones Indices). No conversion between the two.
fights.entriesSentence: Entries (that day's official open): Yardeni SPX 7,678.72 (Nov 5). Minervini SPY 756.80 / SPX 7,586.65 (Nov 11). His claimed Oct 15 entry is shown only as his own statement, not scored.
fights.dataSource: S&P Dow Jones Indices official SPX closes, and the SPY consolidated tape. Entries are that day's official open. Yardeni: SPX 7,678.72 on Nov 5, after a call at 6:42 AM ET (11:42 UTC). Minervini: SPY 756.80 / SPX 7,586.65 on Nov 11, after the locked call at 7:49:52 AM ET (12:49:52 UTC). These are locked prints for judging, not a live quote. No conversion between SPY and SPX.
checkOrder: Yardeni KO: any official SPX close ≥ 7,900.00.
Yardeni TKO: SPY trades intraday at or above Minervini's latest posted stop (now 769.64). A newer posted stop applies from its post time on. A posted cover above his entry counts the same.
Minervini gets no KO. If he posts a cover below 756.80 SPY, the bout ends and is scored as a decision at that day's SPX close.
fights.koSummary: Yardeni KO: any official SPX close ≥ 7,900.00. Minervini gets no KO.
fights.tkoSummary: Yardeni TKO: SPY trades intraday at or above Minervini's latest posted stop (now 769.64). A newer posted stop applies from its post time on. A posted cover above his entry counts the same.
fights.decisionSummary: Decision at Dec 31: Minervini wins if SPX ≤ 7,548.72 (more than 0.5% under his entry). Yardeni wins on points if SPX ≥ 7,717.11. Anything in between is a DRAW. If Minervini posts a cover below 756.80 SPY, the bout ends and is scored as a decision at that day's SPX close. Reported in percent and in points, to two decimals.
fights.drawDetail: Draw band ±0.5% (half the SPX 20-day average absolute daily move of 0.93%). Anything between the two decision levels is a DRAW.

corners.name: Mark Minervini

quotes.label: Locked call
texts: By default, as our long exposure came down, the $SPY short transitioned from being a hedge to leaving us net short the market.
I have now improved that stop to our breakeven price of 769.64, eliminating stop-loss risk on the position.

quotes.label: Nov 12 memo
texts: Yesterday, we doubled our already profitable S&P 500 short exposure because we believe the potential for further downside remains worth the miniscule risk we are taking.

quotes.label: Still short
texts: Our market short positions are doing well. We have not yet covered and remain overweight short. As I posted on Thursday, on 11/11 we doubled our already profitable $SPY short position initiated on 10/15.
